source_refs.note: 1- Study Design and Experimental Planning: a main subheading of 22.1.1 Components of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 186-187.

blocks.text: This involves formulating the research question, determining objectives, and structuring experiments or observational studies to test hypothesis. It includes selecting the population, defining variables, randomization, controlling confounding factors, and calculating adequate sample size. Proper study design ensures validity, reliability, and unbiased results.
